collection.title: BMW 2 Series Gran Tourer 2015 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A BMW 2 Series Gran Tourer 2015 Onwards requires a 26" wiper blade the drivers side and a 19" on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a choice of rear screen wipers for this 2 Series GranTourer which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
